instructions: Follow .github/instructions/conformance.instructions.md (listed in the context files) for this folder. That file is the single source for these notes, shared with Copilot code review.

rules.rule: A source_commit stamp in the corpus must be a commit that main can reach (the squash-merge SHA), not a feature-branch commit, and conformance/record/check_stamps.py enforces this in CI. Flag a change to check_stamps.py or its tests that weakens either check: reachability from main, or the rule that corpus content cannot change without the stamp changing. Flag a new entry in its legacy authored-stamp allowlist.
